description: Local stdio verifier that runs one bounded, network-disabled WPE WebKit acceptance and returns startup, native-input, DOM, fresh-PNG, network, pinned-image, and cleanup evidence.

notes: The local server requires Docker socket access, which grants host-level control; configure it only for a trusted MCP client.

clients: other local stdio MCP clients that support Docker command configuration

notes: Metadata matches the public v0.9.0 source, OCI package, and active official MCP Registry entry io.github.masakaai/jet-browser.
The verifier accepts no URL, profile, credential, path, or arbitrary command and runs both the outer MCP container and browser acceptance with networking disabled.
